title: Organic Origins (Hydrocarbons to Amides)
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: The starting point for CHEM 3B organic chemistry: spot, name, and draw organic compounds, then predict how they react. Eight modes: Spot the Group, 1°/2°/3° classification, Name It, Draw It, Predict the Product, Properties, Med Molecules (labeled groups in 123 real drugs, metabolism intermediates, biomolecules and benzene derivatives, with nursing, dental, anesthesia, imaging and A&P fun facts), and a 60-second Blitz round. Name It and Draw It include Challenge problems with multi-branched IUPAC names (ethyl, propyl, butyl, isopropyl, sec-butyl, isobutyl, tert-butyl). Structures in skeletal, one-line condensed, or branched condensed style. Includes hints, step-by-step naming explanations, XP, streaks, badges, and a Dr. Dan CHEM 3B video playlist.
